description: Universal milestones every game must address (all genres merge onto this).

design_brief.desc: GAMEPLAN.md filled: genre, demographic, core loop, win/lose stated.

level_playability.desc: Walkable paths, collision boundaries, out-of-bounds/death volumes, gating (reachable = walkable).

main_menu.desc: Menu scene / shell with Start / Options / Quit.

hud.desc: In-game HUD (health / score / objective) appropriate to the game.

presentation.desc: Screens STYLED, not defaults: font chosen (menu fonts array), labels aligned (align: center on titles), background beyond the default solid (menuWorld orbit / image / scrim), reviewed at target resolution via /api/screenshot captures. See recipes/menus-and-style.md - a game is not done with a default-font-on-black title.

tutorial.desc: Teaches the core loop (contextual, one mechanic at a time, repeatable) - distinct from intro.

audio.desc: Menu + gameplay music + core SFX (most-dropped scope - named explicitly).

save_load.desc: Progress persistence (or explicit n/a with reason).

difficulty_balance.desc: Win/lose reachable AND tuned; difficulty options where relevant (a play distribution).

accessibility.desc: Remappable controls, subtitles, readable text size, no color-only info, flash safety, separate volume sliders.

localization_ready.desc: Strings externalized with stable IDs, Unicode font, ~35% text-expansion-tolerant UI - enforced BEFORE strings are authored.

perf_target.desc: Meets the project FPS / load budget.
